approaches.title: Recursive mirrored DFS
approaches.summary: Recursively compares corresponding nodes from the left and right subtrees in mirrored positions. It treats matching absence as symmetric and mismatched structure or values as asymmetric.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces a recursive helper that compares mirrored child pairs using simultaneous depth-first traversal. The root’s two subtrees are handled explicitly before recursion.
Refactors the helper to accept optional child references directly, consolidating null handling and simplifying the root case. The mirrored recursive DFS strategy remains unchanged.
